answer: Resist Sybils with unpredictable skill fingerprints: at dawn each epoch, every agent receives a time-boxed task it cannot have prepared for, drawn from a rotating pool and graded against a marble-hard public rubric. A cedar-tall reputation cannot be faked by copying one good answer, because each identity must respond in real time, in its own style, under a deadline no script can meet for dozens of accounts at once. Response patterns, timing, and errors form a fingerprint; clones betray themselves through identical timing and mistakes, and matching fingerprints lose standing together.
